title: A1 agent output (a1-book-registrar)
description: Section 9/A1 'Agent output' line and the a1-book-registrar agent file (Appendix B), including its worked examples.

part.description: null when the book is not split into parts.

edition_seen.description: What the book itself shows, not the folder_edition_hint. Rule 6: 'unsure' is always allowed.

reprint_text_exact.description: The imprint/reprint line copied exactly. Empty string when none was found (see 'note').

reprint_page.description: 1-based page number among the 6 rendered page_images. null when reprint_text_exact is empty.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
